articles.title_en: Migrant selection and sorting during the Great American Drought
articles.title_cn: 大美国干旱期间的移民选择与分类
articles.abstract_en: America’s worst drought spanned the 1930s, coinciding with the most extensive environmental migration in United States history. Nearly 100 years later, we know little about who moved and who stayed. This paper studies heterogeneity in migration from drought by relating migration decisions recorded in the 1940 census to county drought conditions. Drought increased migration primarily for individuals with a 12th-grade education or higher. Drought migrants, both women and men, left rural and urban locations and most often relocated to rural destinations. These findings highlight the importance of individual-level characteristics for adaptation to climate shocks, challenge the perception that rural-to-urban is the dominant environmental migrant channel, and document the central importance of drought for internal migration during the 1930s.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国最严重的干旱跨越了1930年，恰逢美国历史上最广泛的环境移民。近100年后，我们对谁迁移、谁留下知之甚少。本文通过将1940年人口普查中记录的迁移决策与县级干旱状况联系起来，研究干旱导致的迁移异质性。干旱主要增加了具有12年级或以上教育背景的个体的迁移。干旱移民，无论男女，离开农村和城市地区，且最常迁往农村目的地。这些发现强调了个人层面特征对气候冲击适应的重要性，挑战了农村向城市迁移是环境移民主要渠道的看法，并记录了干旱在1930年期间对国内迁移的核心重要性。

articles.title_en: Political settlements analysis and the study of pro-poor development: Laos and Rwanda compared
articles.title_cn: 政治解决分析与前贫发展研究：老挝与卢旺达的比较
articles.abstract_en: Political settlements analysis is a framework that helps us understand different development trajectories. While it has been used to study the politics of pro-poor growth, there has been little explicit engagement with the economic mechanisms that may alleviate or reproduce poverty. This article extends the political settlements approach to that effect and presents a new, integrated framework to account for pro-poor economic development by conceptualizing political conditions as well as key mechanisms – employment and social provision – linking growth and poverty. This framework is empirically applied to scrutinize two recent development ‘success stories’, those of Laos and Rwanda. Both countries have emerged from a violent past to record over two decades of fast economic growth. The paper assesses how they have done so and to what extent their development strategies have been pro-poor. We demonstrate that the combination of economic growth and of centralized and ideologically committed ruling coalitions has enabled large-scale investments in social service provision that have spearheaded significant reductions in multidimensional poverty in Laos and Rwanda. Moreover, key governance capabilities have enabled both countries to achieve a certain degree of structural change. Yet, this change has been misdirected to extractive industries and hydropower (Laos) and high-end services (Rwanda) with weak employment and limited forward and backward linkages, compounded by a relative lack of productivity growth in the historically more relevant agricultural and manufacturing sectors. This has intensified land pressures and vulnerability, leading to increased inequality in Laos and sustaining already high levels of inequality in Rwanda. Using the ambitious conception of pro-poor development that underpins our integrated framework, we problematize these growth trajectories and argue that neither of them has been pro-poor. We recommend that researchers advance political settlements analysis to examine and strengthen the possibilities for social justice-oriented and bottom-up pro-poor development strategies more systematically.
articles.abstract_cn: 政治解决分析是一个帮助我们理解不同发展轨迹的框架。虽然它已被用于研究有利于穷人的增长的政治，但很少明确涉及可能缓解或再生产贫困的经济机制。本文扩展了政治解决方法以达到这一目的，并提出了一个新的、综合性的框架来解释有利于穷人的经济发展，通过概念化政治条件以及连接增长与贫困的关键机制——就业和社会供给。该框架被实证应用于审视两个近期发展“成功故事”，即老挝和卢旺达。这两个国家都从暴力过去中走出来，记录了超过二十年的快速经济增长。本文评估了它们如何实现这一增长，以及它们的发展战略在多大程度上有利于穷人。我们证明，经济增长与集中且意识形态坚定的执政联盟的结合，使得大规模投资于社会服务供给成为可能，从而在老挝和卢旺达引领了多维贫困的显著减少。此外，关键的治理能力使两国能够实现一定程度的结构性变革。然而，这种变革被误导到采掘业和水电（老挝）以及高端服务业（卢旺达），这些行业就业薄弱，前后向联系有限，加之历史上更为相关的农业和制造业部门生产率增长相对缺乏。这加剧了土地压力与脆弱性，导致老挝不平等加剧，并维持了卢旺达本已高水平的不平等。利用我们综合框架所支撑的雄心勃勃的有利于穷人的发展概念，我们对这些增长轨迹提出质疑，并认为它们都不是有利于穷人的。我们建议研究人员推进政治解决分析，更系统地审视和加强面向社会正义和自下而上的有利于穷人的发展战略的可能性。

articles.title_en: The economic consequences of environmental enforcement: Evidence from an anti-deforestation policy in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 环境执法的经济后果：来自巴西反毁林政策的证据
articles.abstract_en: Environmental degradation and economic development are two of the most pressing issues facing the world today, and public policy that aims to address one of these may unintentionally affect the other. I study the effect of an increase in environmental law enforcement on local economic conditions in rural Brazil. In the first part of this paper, I use data on more targeted anti-deforestation law enforcement activities, guided by satellite alerts, and link that to local forest conversion. I then exploit the staggered introduction of a policy that increases monitoring and enforcement in municipalities with a history of high deforestation, and link this to a range of economic development outcomes. I find that more targeted law enforcement reduces conversion rates of forest to farm land. Furthermore, economic conditions in municipalities with stricter monitoring improve, indicating that environmental enforcement and economic development need not be at odds.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境退化与经济发展是当今世界面临的两个最紧迫的问题，旨在解决其中之一的公共政策可能会无意中影响另一个。我研究了环境执法力度的加强对巴西农村地区地方经济状况的影响。在本文的第一部分，我使用了基于卫星警报的更有针对性的反毁林执法活动数据，并将其与当地森林转换联系起来。然后，我利用一项政策的交错引入，该政策加强了对有高毁林历史的城市的监测和执法，并将其与一系列经济发展结果联系起来。我发现，更有针对性的执法降低了森林向农田的转换率。此外，监测更严格的城市的经济发展状况有所改善，这表明环境执法与经济发展不必相互矛盾。

articles.title_en: Appropriation pathways of water grabbing
articles.title_cn: 水资源攫取的占有路径
articles.abstract_en: The appropriation of water by farmers, land investors, mining operations, hydropower corporations, or other actors becomes controversial when it targets relatively scarce water resources that support rural livelihoods, food security, or environmental needs. Some of the distinctive institutional and hydrological conditions underlying water appropriations remain poorly understood, thus limiting the development of suitable policy and governance instruments to protect those users whose access to water is diminished by such appropriations. Research in this field has often focused on water acquisitions through land deals or infrastructure development while overlooking other more subtle pathways of water appropriation associated with pollution, land use change, afforestation, land–atmosphere feedback, irrigation efficiency, and virtual water trade. Such pathways frequently contribute to the loss of access to water by prior users, including rural communities, indigenous groups, women, and the environment, thus playing a critical role in undermining livelihoods, cultural identity, or ecosystem functions. Understanding the socio-environmental interplay between the institutional-legal and hydrological mechanism is crucial to the assessment of how different water appropriation pathways can affect prior users and their rights. Here we examine the different institutional and biophysical conditions that characterize the dynamics of water appropriation and identify the major pathways underlying water grabbing. We investigate the nexus between water tenure arrangements and neglected hydrological pathways of water appropriation to critically evaluate their impact on access to water.
articles.abstract_cn: 农民、土地投资者、采矿作业、水电公司或其他行为者对水资源的占有，当其针对支持农村生计、粮食安全或环境需求的相对稀缺水资源时，便具有争议性。水资源占有背后的一些独特制度和水文条件仍未被充分理解，从而限制了制定适当的政策与治理工具来保护那些因这类占有而减少水资源获取的用户。该领域的研究往往侧重于通过土地交易或基础设施开发进行的水资源获取，而忽视了与污染、土地利用变化、造林、陆气反馈、灌溉效率和虚拟水贸易相关的其他更为隐蔽的水资源占有路径。这些路径常常导致先前用户（包括农村社区、土著群体、妇女和环境）失去水资源获取机会，从而在削弱生计、文化认同或生态系统功能方面发挥关键作用。理解制度法律与水文机制之间的社会环境相互作用，对于评估不同水资源占有路径如何影响先前用户及其权利至关重要。在此，我们考察了表征水资源占有动态的不同制度和生物物理条件，并识别了水资源攫取的主要路径。我们研究了水权安排与被忽视的水资源占有的水文路径之间的联系，以批判性评估其对水资源获取的影响。

articles.title_en: Understanding ‘refugee resettlement’ from below: Decoding the Rohingya refugees’ lived experience in Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 从底层理解“难民重新安置”：解读孟加拉国罗兴亚难民的生活经历
articles.abstract_en: While the resettlement of displaced people often denotes rehabilitation in one way or another, the paper illuminates the paradox of resettlement between repatriation and relocation with the case of Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh. The Rohingya, considered the most persecuted ethnic minority in the world at present as per the United Nations (UN), are an ethnolinguistic and religious minority of Myanmar but at present most of them are living in Bangladesh as refugees. About 750 thousand Rohingyas fled a deadly genocidal attack perpetrated by the Myanmar security forces in 2017 and took refuge in Bangladesh. Combining with the previously living ones, Bangladesh now hosts more than 1.3 million Rohingyas as refugees in 34 temporary camps in Ukhia and Teknaf, two south-eastern sub-districts of Cox’s Bazar. This massive Rohingya presence has heavily impacted the local lives and resources and thereby the local community gradually became reluctant, though not yet hostile, to host them anymore. To accommodate the local pressure, Bangladesh made two consecutive repatriation attempts (the first one on November 15, 2018, and the second one on August 22, 2019) to send the Rohingya back to Myanmar but failed since none willingly returned to their ‘homeland’. The refusal was interpreted as non-cooperation of the international community, and non-preparation on Myanmar's part to accept the Rohingyas back and let them resume their lives safely in the Rakhine state where they used to live. Since the repatriation attempt did not work and local pressures started mounting, Bangladesh initiated a program to relocate a few thousand Rohingya families to Bhasan Char, a newly emerged island located in the Bay of Bengal under Noakhali district. Empirical data reveal that the physical facilities of Bhasan Char seem far better than the same of Ukhia and Teknaf. Still, Rohingya refugees remain reluctant to move due to their entrenched fear of cyclones, floods and tidal surges which, they believe, could wash them away anytime. The entire process of Rohingya relocation to Bhasan Char has created huge debates about whether the Island is safe-liveable for the Rohingya people since it is a twenty-year-old island and there was no experience of people living there. Still, it does not appear to be a convincing plan to resolve the displacement problem of the Rohingya refugees. Given the background, what the Rohingya people articulate their aspiration in the name of resettlement is completely missing in the entire planning and action to redress the Rohingya crisis. Empirical findings show that the majority of Rohingyas are willing to return ‘home’ if three conditions are met: legal recognition amid conferring citizenship, social safety through the deployment of UN peace troops, and human dignity so that they can enjoy all forms of human rights. So, the Rohingya perception of resettlement is repatriation with aforesaid conditions. Therefore, the paper argues that beyond the populist idea of resettlement in the form of rehabilitation or relocation, the whole discourse of resettlement could come up from the bottom and people’s perspectives which could be both crucial and instrumental in policy framing and action planning. The Rohingya refugees desire dignified repatriation with legal recognition and social safety which is largely absent in the activism of the human rights bodies and the action of the international communities as well as the state-level movements. Given the matrix of relocation and repatriation, resettlement takes a central point of discussion and debates whether resettlement could settle the Rohingya crisis in the place of migration. The paper with the experience of decade-long ethnographic research intends to rearticulate the people’s perception and ground-level view of (re)settlement to redress the Rohingya crisis in the interface of repatriation and relocation.
articles.abstract_cn: 虽然流离失所者的重新安置通常以某种方式意味着康复，但本文通过孟加拉国罗兴亚难民的案例，阐明了遣返与搬迁之间重新安置的悖论。罗兴亚人被认为是目前世界上受迫害最严重的少数民族（根据联合国的说法），他们是缅甸的族裔语言和宗教少数群体，但目前大多数人作为难民生活在孟加拉国。约750万罗兴亚人在2017年逃离缅甸安全部队实施的致命种族灭绝袭击，并在孟加拉国避难。加上先前居住的人，孟加拉国现在在考克斯巴扎尔东南部的两个分区乌基亚和特克纳夫的1.3个临时营地收容了超过34万罗兴亚难民。罗兴亚人的大量存在严重影响了当地的生活和资源，因此当地社区逐渐变得不情愿（尽管尚未敌对）继续收容他们。为了缓解当地压力，孟加拉国进行了两次连续的遣返尝试（第一次在15年十一月2018日，第二次在22年八月2019日），试图将罗兴亚人送回缅甸，但均未成功，因为没有人愿意返回他们的“家园”。拒绝被解释为国际社会的不合作，以及缅甸方面未准备好接受罗兴亚人返回并让他们在若开邦安全恢复生活。由于遣返尝试未奏效，当地压力开始增加，孟加拉国启动了一项计划，将数千个罗兴亚家庭搬迁到位于诺阿卡利区孟加拉湾的新兴岛屿巴山查尔。实证数据显示，巴山查尔的物理设施似乎远优于乌基亚和特克纳夫。尽管如此，罗兴亚难民仍然不愿搬迁，因为他们对气旋、洪水和风暴潮的根深蒂固的恐惧，他们认为这些随时可能将他们冲走。罗兴亚人搬迁到巴山查尔的整个过程引发了关于该岛是否适合罗兴亚人安全居住的巨大争议，因为它是一个有二十年历史的岛屿，且没有人在那里居住的经验。尽管如此，这似乎并不是解决罗兴亚难民流离失所问题的令人信服的计划。在此背景下，罗兴亚人以重新安置之名表达他们的愿望，在解决罗兴亚危机的整个规划和行动中完全缺失。实证研究结果表明，如果满足三个条件，大多数罗兴亚人愿意返回“家园”：获得公民身份的法律承认、通过部署联合国维和部队实现社会安全，以及享有各种形式人权的人类尊严。因此，罗兴亚人对重新安置的看法是带有上述条件的遣返。因此，本文认为，在康复或搬迁形式的民粹主义重新安置观念之外，整个重新安置话语可以从底层和人民的角度出发，这在政策制定和行动规划中可能既关键又具有工具性。罗兴亚难民渴望有尊严的遣返，并伴有法律承认和社会安全，而这在人权机构的活动、国际社会的行动以及国家层面的运动中基本缺失。在搬迁和遣返的矩阵中，重新安置成为讨论和辩论的中心点，即重新安置能否在移民问题上解决罗兴亚危机。本文基于长达十年的民族志研究经验，旨在重新阐述人民对（重新）安置的看法和基层观点，以在遣返与搬迁的交叉中解决罗兴亚危机。

articles.title_en: Vent-for-surplus in Southeast Asian development since 1870
articles.title_cn: 1870年以来东南亚发展中的剩余出路
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a new vent-for-surplus model to analyze Southeast Asia’s two phases of rapid export-led growth. During the first, from 1870 to 1929, international trade provided the ‘vent’ to utilize frontier land and labour surpluses in the production of primary commodities. Intra-regional exchange both allowed and created specialization. Four commodities— rice, rubber, tin and sugar — accounted for most exports. A second growth phase from 1970 depended on exporting manufactures and vented surplus labour through trade or its substitute of emigration. Western markets and regional integration again drove growth, transforming Southeast Asian countries from agricultural to predominantly industrial. This time, Southeast Asian development depended on integration with markets in the West but, crucially, also on supply chains within the region to enable specialization. By giving scope for consumer preferences and regional integration, the model can better explain the realities of Southeast Asia’s growth and extreme specialization. In both phases, trade served as the growth engine, but in neither was technical change the chief expansionary source.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个新的剩余出路模型，用以分析东南亚两个阶段的快速出口导向型增长。第一阶段，从1870年到1929年，国际贸易提供了‘出路’，利用边疆土地和劳动力剩余生产初级商品。区域内交换既允许也创造了专业化。四种商品——大米、橡胶、锡和糖——占据了大部分出口。第二阶段，从1970年开始，依赖于制成品出口，并通过贸易或其替代形式——移民——来释放剩余劳动力。西方市场和区域一体化再次推动了增长，将东南亚国家从农业国转变为以工业为主的国家。这一次，东南亚的发展依赖于与西方市场的整合，但关键在于，也依赖于区域内供应链以实现专业化。通过考虑消费者偏好和区域一体化，该模型能更好地解释东南亚增长和极端专业化的现实。在两个阶段中，贸易都充当了增长引擎，但技术变革都不是主要的扩张来源。

articles.title_en: Cash-based interventions improve multidimensional integration outcomes of Venezuelan immigrants
articles.title_cn: 现金干预改善委内瑞拉移民的多维融合结果
articles.abstract_en: Since 2015, over 7 million Venezuelans have been forced to leave their homes, seeking refuge predominantly in neighboring countries across Latin America and the Caribbean. The displacement is typically accompanied by vulnerability and marginalization, yet there is a scarcity of actionable evidence on how to alleviate poverty among immigrants and refugees and facilitate their economic, political, and social integration. This study evaluates the impact of a cash-based intervention (CBI) on multidimensional integration outcomes of highly vulnerable Venezuelan immigrants, predominantly women, residing in Peru. Utilizing an original panel survey of beneficiaries and the staggered rollout of the program, which provided a one-time payment of 760 soles (approximately 190 USD or 74% of the monthly minimum wage), we estimate that the CBI increased the IPL-24 index – an overall measure of immigrant integration capturing several dimensions – by at least 0.12 standard deviations. Moreover, the CBI boosted self-employment by 2 percentage points and raised the intention to emigrate from Peru by 1.2 percentage points. Additionally, our heterogeneity analysis reveals that the benefits of the fixed-amount cash payment diminish significantly with the size of the household. We discuss how these findings inform the design of future CBI programs aimed at supporting vulnerable immigrant and refugee families.
articles.abstract_cn: 自2015年以来，超过7百万委内瑞拉人被迫离开家园，主要寻求在拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的邻国避难。流离失所通常伴随着脆弱性和边缘化，然而关于如何减轻移民和难民的贫困并促进其经济、政治和社会融合的可操作证据却十分匮乏。本研究评估了一项现金干预（CBI）对居住在秘鲁的高度脆弱委内瑞拉移民（主要为女性）多维融合结果的影响。利用一项原始面板调查和该项目的分阶段推出（该项目提供一次性支付760索尔，约合190美元或74%的月最低工资），我们估计CBI使IPL-24指数（一项涵盖多个维度的移民融合总体衡量指标）至少提高了0.12个标准差。此外，CBI使自雇就业率提高了2个百分点，并将在秘鲁的移民意愿提高了1.2个百分点。另外，我们的异质性分析显示，固定金额现金支付的好处随着家庭规模的增大而显著减少。我们讨论了这些发现如何为未来旨在支持脆弱移民和难民家庭的CBI项目设计提供信息。

articles.title_en: The effects of mobile primary health teams: Evidence from the Médico del Barrio strategy in Ecuador
articles.title_cn: 流动初级卫生团队的效果：来自厄瓜多尔“街区医生”战略的证据
articles.abstract_en: Starting in 2017, Ecuador gradually expanded its primary healthcare access program nationwide using mobile traveling healthcare teams through the Estrategia Médico del Barrio (EMB) [or Neighborhood Doctor Strategy]. EMB teams, composed of a primary care physician, a nurse, and a community health worker, made home visits in marginalized areas. We estimate the impact of the EMB on health and utilization outcomes using nationally representative household surveys for 2006 (N = 55,666), 2012–13 (N = 92,500) and 2018–19 (N = 168,747). The treatment variable at the extensive margin is any exposure to EMB at the canton level. At the intensive margin, we use exposure in terms of weeks covered by EMB and the number and composition of EMB personnel per 1000 population. We identify outcomes of treated vs. non- or partially-treated cantons based on the random combination of the timing of the start of the program’s implementation and the timing of the survey interview, which varied across cantons. We use difference-in-difference (DD) and difference-in-difference-in-difference (DDD) frameworks, the latter for cantons with high indigenous concentration. We find significant effects on the reported health problem and preventive care, but mixed results in terms of curative healthcare. The DDD specification shows that EMB improved health problem diagnoses and preventive healthcare utilization, including in highly indigenous cantons, yet it seemed to have mixed results in terms of curative care use in Ecuador. Various alternative specifications and robustness tests do not qualitatively alter the main findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 自2017年起，厄瓜多尔通过“街区医生”战略（EMB）逐步在全国范围内扩展其初级医疗保健可及性项目，利用流动巡回医疗团队。EMB团队由一名初级保健医生、一名护士和一名社区卫生工作者组成，在边缘化地区进行家访。我们利用2006年（样本量 = 55,666）、2012-13年（样本量 = 92,500）和2018-19年（样本量 = 168,747）的全国代表性住户调查，评估EMB对健康和利用结果的影响。在广泛边际上的处理变量是县级对EMB的任何暴露。在密集边际上，我们使用EMB覆盖周数以及每1000人口中EMB人员数量和构成的暴露。我们基于项目实施开始时间与调查访谈时间的随机组合（在不同县间变化），识别处理县与未处理或部分处理县的结果。我们使用双重差分（DD）和三重差分（DDD）框架，后者适用于高土著人口集中度的县。我们发现对报告的健康问题和预防性护理有显著影响，但在治疗性医疗保健方面结果不一。DDD规格显示，EMB改善了健康问题诊断和预防性医疗保健利用，包括在高土著县，但在厄瓜多尔的治疗性护理使用方面似乎结果不一。各种替代规格和稳健性检验并未在性质上改变主要发现。

articles.title_en: Rely on children or work longer? The impact of fertility and child gender on old-age labor supply
articles.title_cn: 依靠子女还是延长工作年限？生育和子女性别对老年劳动供给的影响
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we examine the impact of child quantity and gender on the labor supply of older parents in China, specifically in the context of developing countries where working until physically incapable is a widespread self-insurance strategy. Utilizing an instrumental variable approach that leverages regional family planning policy variations and firstborn child gender, we address potential endogeneity concerns in fertility and child gender composition. Our findings indicate that an additional child reduces the likelihood of parents working at post-retirement ages by 9.9 percentage points, with a more pronounced effect among rural parents and those receiving low pension benefits. Furthermore, having more sons further decreases labor supply compared to having more daughters, given the same number of children. We uncover evidence supporting the “old-age support” mechanism, wherein financial contributions and informal care from children increase, while lifetime labor supply and accumulated wealth decrease. We do not find evidence for adverse impact of fertility on parents’ health or their capacity to work. Having more children can essentially compensate the wage loss due to working less. Our results imply that policies aiming at reducing fertility might inadvertently undermine the well-being of older individuals,especially those who lack sufficient means of support, by forcing them to continue working into poor health during their old age.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们考察了子女数量和性别对中国老年父母劳动供给的影响，特别是在发展中国家，工作到身体无法胜任是一种普遍的自我保险策略的背景下。利用工具变量方法，结合地区计划生育政策差异和第一个孩子的性别，我们解决了生育和子女性别构成中潜在的内生性问题。我们的研究结果表明，每多一个孩子，父母在退休年龄后工作的可能性降低9.9个百分点，这一效应在农村父母和领取低养老金的人群中更为显著。此外，在子女数量相同的情况下，拥有更多儿子相比拥有更多女儿会进一步减少劳动供给。我们发现了支持“养老支持”机制的证据，即子女的经济贡献和非正式照料增加，而终身劳动供给和累积财富减少。我们没有发现生育对父母健康或其工作能力产生不利影响的证据。拥有更多孩子基本上可以补偿因减少工作而造成的工资损失。我们的结果意味着，旨在降低生育率的政策可能会无意中损害老年人的福祉，特别是那些缺乏足够支持手段的人，迫使他们不得不在年老体弱时继续工作。

articles.title_en: Social protection and formalization in low- and middle-income countries: A scoping review of the literature
articles.title_cn: 中低收入国家的社会保护与正规化：文献范围综述
articles.abstract_en: Social protection is a central component of achieving ‘SDG 8: decent work and economic growth’, yet at a global level a large social protection deficit remains. The majority of those uncovered are found in or dependent on income or profit from the informal economy, which remains the dominant source of employment in many low- and middle-income countries. The relationship between a lack of social protection and high informality in low- and middle-income countries is generally confirmed across the literature, yet the perceived direction of the relation and the mechanisms behind it vary depending on the country-specific context, including dominant form(s) of informality and types of social protection schemes and benefits provided. Much of the existing literature on social protection and (in)formalization examines the relation between non-contributory social protection (social assistance) and the broader concept of the informal economy. Taking a different focus, this article reviews the evidence on the relationship between contributory social protection and formalization of enterprises and workers among micro- and small enterprises in low- and middle-income countries. We adopt a scoping review methodology and follow a thorough literature search and screening process in which 30 primarily quantitative studies are carefully synthesized. In analysing the main findings and mechanisms underlying the observed linkages between contributory social protection and formalization, our study finds substantial variation across as well as within countries. In general, the evidence paints a favourable picture in terms of contributory social protection leading to increased formalization of enterprises and workers, yet it is not a given that enterprise formalization (the extensive margin) automatically leads to worker formalization (the intensive margin). The results point to the importance of appropriate incentive structures in social protection policies as well as ensuring stronger coherence and coordination between different types of social protection schemes and other labour market policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会保护是实现‘可持续发展目标8：体面工作和经济增长’的核心组成部分，然而在全球层面仍存在巨大的社会保护赤字。大多数未被覆盖的人群处于非正规经济中或依赖其收入或利润，而非正规经济仍是许多中低收入国家的主要就业来源。文献普遍证实了中低收入国家缺乏社会保护与高非正规性之间的关系，但关系的感知方向和背后的机制因国家具体情况而异，包括非正规性的主要形式和所提供的社会保护计划及福利类型。现有关于社会保护与（非）正规化的文献大多考察非缴费型社会保护（社会救助）与非正规经济这一更广泛概念之间的关系。本文采取不同的侧重点，回顾了中低收入国家中缴费型社会保护与微型和小型企业及其工人正规化之间关系的证据。我们采用范围综述方法，经过彻底的文献检索和筛选过程，综合分析了30项主要为定量研究的研究。在分析缴费型社会保护与正规化之间观察到的关联的主要发现和机制时，我们的研究发现国家内部和国家之间存在显著差异。总体而言，证据描绘了一幅有利的图景，即缴费型社会保护导致企业和工人正规化程度提高，但企业正规化（广延边际）并不必然导致工人正规化（集约边际）。结果指出了社会保护政策中适当激励结构的重要性，以及确保不同类型社会保护计划与其他劳动力市场政策之间更强一致性和协调性的必要性。

articles.title_en: Tracing China’s agrochemical complex
articles.title_cn: 追踪中国的农化综合体
articles.abstract_en: Chinese firms, both private and state-owned, have transformed the global agrochemical complex. China dominates exports of pesticides (particularly herbicides) and various kinds of nitrogen- and phosphorous-based fertilisers. And yet the precise nature of this transformation is poorly understood: where are Chinese agrochemicals made and by whom; in what ways is domestic production changing; which actors are active in the export market; and what is flowing where? In this article we begin to flesh out some of the detail of China’s massive agrochemical complex and its internal dynamics by examining key actors and flows in China’s agrochemical export industry. Our analysis is framed by insights drawn from the Global China literature and from pesticide studies. We find two distinct industries, both of which are in flux. Domestic environmental regulations and industry upgrading are reconfiguring the landscape for mining and chemical production, resulting in a scaling back of pesticide and fertiliser production, while mergers and acquisitions are concentrating production and export capacity in particular firms. Export flows are nonetheless growing in a generally favourable export environment. Concealed in the generic categories ‘pesticide’ and ‘fertiliser’ is the fact that different products go to different destinations and do so in patterns that complicate North-South categories. Our analysis highlights the need for new commodity geographies of Chinese-made agrochemicals that can account for production, circulation, and use.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国公司，无论是私营还是国有，已经改变了全球农化综合体。中国主导了农药（尤其是除草剂）以及各种氮基和磷基肥料的出口。然而，这种转变的确切性质尚不清楚：中国的农化产品在哪里生产，由谁生产；国内生产正在以何种方式变化；哪些参与者活跃在出口市场；以及什么流向哪里？在本文中，我们通过考察中国农化出口行业的关键参与者和流动，开始详细阐述中国庞大的农化综合体及其内部动态。我们的分析以全球中国文献和农药研究的见解为框架。我们发现两个截然不同的行业，两者都在变化之中。国内环境法规和产业升级正在重新配置采矿和化工生产的格局，导致农药和化肥生产缩减，而并购正在将生产和出口能力集中在特定公司。尽管如此，在总体有利的出口环境下，出口流量仍在增长。隐藏在“农药”和“化肥”这些通用类别背后的事实是，不同的产品流向不同的目的地，其模式使南北分类复杂化。我们的分析强调需要新的中国制造农化产品的商品地理学，以解释生产、流通和使用。

articles.title_en: Do aid agencies comply with human rights requirements in Practice? Systematic evidence on the integration of human rights in German development cooperation
articles.title_cn: 援助机构在实践中是否遵守人权要求？德国发展合作中人权利整合的系统性证据
articles.abstract_en: When are human rights integrated into bilateral development cooperation projects? While researchers investigated human rights mainstreaming in development policy and the allocation of foreign aid across states, we lack systematic evidence of effective implementation of human rights mainstreaming at project level. Drawing on principal-agent-theory, we formulate expectations on the conditions under which implementing agencies of development projects comply with donor governments’ requirement for human rights mainstreaming. Using supervised text classification and mixed effects regressions on 761 German development project proposals, we find that mainstreaming is incomplete across projects and primarily focusses on measures to prevent abuses rather than to proactively promote human rights. Implementing agencies better comply with mainstreaming policies in sectors whose objectives are linked to human right priorities, e.g., in the health or education sectors. Human rights mainstreaming also becomes more likely if agencies have more organizational resources and less autonomy from the donor government. The human rights record of the partner government does not influence the extent of human rights mainstreaming but affects how exactly mainstreaming is implemented. Specifically, when partner governments violate human rights, implementing agencies avoid working with state actors and prioritize empowering marginalized groups. This suggests that implementing agencies bypass state actors to reduce the operational and political costs of integrating human rights in development projects. Our findings underscore the need to be attentive to the costs of human rights mainstreaming for development cooperation agencies and implement better follow-up and donor enforcement mechanisms to close the gap between donors’ human rights commitments and effective implementation at project level.
articles.abstract_cn: 人权何时被纳入双边发展合作项目？虽然研究人员调查了发展政策中的人权主流化以及外国援助在国家间的分配，但我们缺乏关于项目层面人权主流化有效实施的系统性证据。基于委托-代理理论，我们提出了关于发展项目实施机构在何种条件下遵守捐助国政府人权主流化要求的预期。通过对761个德国发展项目提案进行监督文本分类和混合效应回归，我们发现主流化在项目间并不完整，且主要侧重于预防滥用的措施，而非积极促进人权。实施机构在目标与人权优先事项相关的部门（如卫生或教育部门）中更好地遵守主流化政策。如果机构拥有更多的组织资源且对捐助国政府的自主性较低，人权主流化也更有可能发生。伙伴政府的人权记录不影响人权主流化的程度，但影响主流化的具体实施方式。具体而言，当伙伴政府侵犯人权时，实施机构避免与国家行为体合作，并优先赋权边缘化群体。这表明实施机构绕过国家行为体，以降低将人权纳入发展项目的运营和政治成本。我们的发现强调，需要关注人权主流化对发展合作机构的成本，并实施更好的后续跟进和捐助者执行机制，以缩小捐助者人权承诺与项目层面有效实施之间的差距。

articles.title_en: Mass involuntary migration and educational attainment
articles.title_cn: 大规模非自愿迁移与教育成就
articles.abstract_en: Forcible displacement of children disrupts their social capital, and education is of primary importance regarding their integration into the host communities. Millions of individuals found themselves on the “wrong side” of the border when British India was Partitioned purely along religious lines in 1947, leading to mass-scale violence and migration. These migrants received very little state support because the host states were severely resource-constrained, but they were treated as citizens of the newly formed states. In this paper, I combine survey data with digitized archives of historical census data to study the effect of this large-scale permanent displacement event on the human capital attainment of forcibly displaced children. I use a cohort-age based differences-in-differences approach to show that individuals of school-going age, who were born in India and migrated to Pakistan, have a higher likelihood of completing primary and secondary education than natives in the same birth cohorts. I show that migrants’ initial choices regarding location and occupation are two important potential mechanisms that point towards the existence of the “uprootedness hypothesis”. My findings provide important insights for the integration of migrants into the host communities and underscore the need to better understand the comparative efficacy of different methods used for supporting forcibly displaced communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 儿童被迫流离失所会破坏其社会资本，而教育对于他们融入接收社区至关重要。当英属印度在1947年纯粹按照宗教界限被分割时，数百万人发现自己处于边界的“错误一侧”，导致了大规模暴力和迁移。这些移民几乎没有得到国家支持，因为接收国资源严重受限，但他们被视为新成立国家的公民。在本文中，我将调查数据与历史人口普查数据的数字化档案相结合，研究这一大规模永久性流离失所事件对被迫流离失所儿童人力资本成就的影响。我采用基于队列年龄的双重差分方法，表明出生于印度并迁移至巴基斯坦的学龄个体，其完成小学和中学教育的可能性高于同出生队列的本地人。我表明，移民在初始地点和职业上的选择是两个重要的潜在机制，指向“连根拔起假说”的存在。我的发现为移民融入接收社区提供了重要见解，并强调需要更好地理解支持被迫流离失所社区的不同方法的相对有效性。

articles.title_en: Informal institutions and “Imperfect Equity” in internationally financed adaptation in Madagascar and Mauritius
articles.title_cn: 非正式制度与马达加斯加和毛里求斯国际融资适应中的“不完美公平”
articles.abstract_en: International adaptation finance is key to climate justice, yet concern is growing that funding is inequitable and failing to reach the communities most vulnerable to climate impacts. Under UN climate funds, national governments play an important role in distributing adaptation finance within their borders. Informal institutions, such as clientelism and patronage, have been shown to influence governments’ distribution of public resources, in many cases undermining equity. This comparative case study examines how patronage in Madagascar and clientelism in Mauritius influenced government decision-making in two UN Adaptation Fund projects. We draw on 105 interviews with national level policymakers, civil society representatives, and Adaptation Fund project actors. We find that informal institutions strongly influenced decision-making and distribution of project benefits in both countries, but the projects diverged significantly in meeting the Adaptation Fund’s mandate to benefit “particularly vulnerable” communities. We identify two primary characteristics that explain these divergent outcomes: the interaction of informal institutions with formal institutions of accountability; and the alignment of formal and informal incentives for project actors to advance equity. We argue that adaptation organizations should adopt an “imperfect equity” approach that focuses on positive outcomes and understanding the circumstances under which they occur. Such an approach can yield insights that inform concrete strategies for navigating informal institutions, while contributing to progress toward more equitable and accountable institutions long-term.
articles.abstract_cn: 国际适应融资是气候正义的关键，但人们日益担忧资金分配不公平，且未能惠及最易受气候影响的社区。在联合国气候基金下，国家政府在国内分配适应融资方面发挥着重要作用。非正式制度，如庇护主义和裙带关系，已被证明会影响政府公共资源的分配，在许多情况下损害公平。本比较案例研究考察了马达加斯加的庇护主义和毛里求斯的裙带关系如何影响两个联合国适应基金项目的政府决策。我们基于对105名国家层面政策制定者、民间社会代表和适应基金项目参与者的访谈。我们发现，非正式制度在两国都强烈影响了决策和项目收益的分配，但项目在满足适应基金惠及“特别脆弱”社区的使命方面存在显著差异。我们确定了解释这些不同结果的两个主要特征：非正式制度与正式问责制度的互动；以及正式和非正式激励对项目参与者推进公平的一致性。我们认为，适应组织应采取“不完美公平”方法，侧重于积极成果并理解这些成果发生的环境。这种方法可以产生见解，为应对非正式制度的具体策略提供信息，同时长期促进向更公平和更负责任的制度迈进。

articles.title_en: Effective land ownership, female empowerment, and food security: Evidence from Peru
articles.title_cn: 有效的土地所有权、女性赋权与粮食安全：来自秘鲁的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effect of women’s informal land ownership on women’s empowerment and household food security in the context of Peruvian family farming. Using an instrumental variable approach, we explore whether self-declared informal ownership of plots provides women with increased bargaining power, empowering them to participate more actively in productive decision-making as well as endowing them with the necessary resources to improve crop diversity and food security. While our results do not find significant effects of informal land ownership on three dimensions of women’s empowerment (production, income, credit), we do find that owning land significantly decreases the daily time dedicated to agricultural work, possibly freeing up time for the woman to engage in other activities. Results also show that women’s land ownership significantly increases the level of crop diversity and improves the household’s probability of being food secure by 20 percentage points. This suggests that equal access to land, even without formal title, plays an important role in improving household welfare among smallholder family farmers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在秘鲁家庭农业背景下，女性非正式土地所有权对女性赋权和家庭粮食安全的影响。使用工具变量方法，我们探讨自我申报的非正式地块所有权是否为女性提供了更强的议价能力，使她们能够更积极地参与生产决策，并赋予她们必要的资源以改善作物多样性和粮食安全。虽然我们的结果未发现非正式土地所有权对女性赋权的三个维度（生产、收入、信贷）有显著影响，但我们确实发现拥有土地显著减少了每日用于农业劳动的时间，可能为女性腾出时间参与其他活动。结果还表明，女性土地所有权显著提高了作物多样性水平，并将家庭粮食安全的概率提高了20个百分点。这表明，即使没有正式所有权，平等获得土地在小农家庭农场中改善家庭福利方面也发挥着重要作用。

articles.title_en: Unravelling the nexus of illicit gold trade, protection rackets, and political settlement dynamics: Evidence from Burkina Faso
articles.title_cn: 揭示非法黄金贸易、保护费勒索与政治和解动态之间的关联：来自布基纳法索的证据
articles.abstract_en: A significant share of gold from artisanal and small-scale mining is produced informally or illegally. Most of this gold is traded outside official channels, resulting in illicit financial flows that deprive governments of much-needed revenue, and some of these flows are also used to finance armed conflict and launder money from other illicit activities. We apply a political economy lens to the analysis of illicit gold markets to study their intersection with state-building dynamics and political settlements, with a view to understanding the function these markets fulfil even though they seem highly dysfunctional from an institutionalist perspective. In Burkina Faso, we find that the modus operandi of the artisanal gold market has become a function of political competition, aided by well-meaning policy reforms. State-sponsored protection rackets enable and shape the illicit gold market, putting off-budget resources at the disposal of factions competing for political dominance. Drafting new legislation or building capacity for enforcement is unlikely to overcome the impasse. To rein in illicit financial flows, understanding the political-economy dynamics inherent in the functioning of illicit gold markets is critical for defining policy interventions responsive to the prevailing actor configuration.
articles.abstract_cn: 手工和小规模采矿生产的黄金中有很大一部分是非正式或非法生产的。这些黄金大多在官方渠道之外交易，导致非法资金流动，使政府失去急需的收入，其中一些资金还被用于资助武装冲突和洗白其他非法活动的资金。我们运用政治经济学视角分析非法黄金市场，研究其与国家建设动态和政治和解的交汇点，以期理解这些市场所发挥的功能，尽管从制度主义角度看它们似乎高度功能失调。在布基纳法索，我们发现手工黄金市场的运作方式已成为政治竞争的一个函数，并受到善意政策改革的推动。国家支持的保护费勒索使非法黄金市场得以运作并塑造其形态，将预算外资源置于争夺政治主导地位的派系手中。起草新立法或加强执法能力不太可能打破僵局。要遏制非法资金流动，理解非法黄金市场运作中固有的政治经济动态，对于制定符合当前行为者格局的政策干预至关重要。

articles.title_en: Climate adaptation policies and rural income: Evidence from social technologies in Brazil
articles.title_cn: 气候适应政策与农村收入：来自巴西社会技术的证据
articles.abstract_en: Several developing countries have implemented programs to support rural families, but there is still a lack of evidence on their effectiveness. This paper seeks to address the existing gap by analyzing the impact of the Second Water Cisterns Program (SWCP) on the income of Brazilian family farmers. The policy intervention consists of a social technology that harvests rainwater for use in agriculture. We combined data from family farmers with administrative data from the program, identifying the participation status of each farmer. Using the Differences in Differences strategy and exploring the time when the farms received the cistern over the period from 2007 to 2016, our results show that the SWCP has a positive impact on the income of rural farms, causing an increase of 5.9%. Heterogeneous effects indicate a greater magnitude of impact among low-income and smaller family farmers. Moreover, the effect is more pronounced for farmers in municipalities with a lower share of agriculture in the total economy as well as for farmers in municipalities with lower rainfall. Our findings highlight the importance of production and productivity as a potential mechanism for raising the income level of rural farmers, with the impact concentrating on low-income family farmers. Based on the cost–benefit analysis, each Brazilian Real invested in SWCP generates an average return of approximately BRL 0.11. These findings suggest that the provision of low-cost social technologies to families in rural areas may be an important mechanism for local economic development.
articles.abstract_cn: 一些发展中国家已经实施了支持农村家庭的计划，但关于其有效性的证据仍然缺乏。本文旨在通过分析第二水窖计划（SWCP）对巴西家庭农户收入的影响来填补现有空白。该政策干预包括一种收集雨水用于农业的社会技术。我们将家庭农户的数据与计划的行政数据相结合，识别每个农户的参与状态。使用双重差分策略，并利用2007年至2016年间农场获得水窖的时间，我们的结果表明，SWCP对农村农场的收入有积极影响，导致收入增加5.9%。异质性效应表明，在低收入和规模较小的家庭农户中，影响幅度更大。此外，对于农业在整体经济中占比较低的市镇以及降雨量较低的市镇的农户，影响更为显著。我们的发现强调了生产和生产力作为提高农村农民收入水平的潜在机制的重要性，其影响集中在低收入家庭农户上。基于成本效益分析，每投资一巴西雷亚尔于SWCP，平均产生约0.11巴西雷亚尔的回报。这些发现表明，向农村地区家庭提供低成本社会技术可能是地方经济发展的重要机制。

articles.title_en: Thriving in the rain: natural shocks, time allocation, and women’s empowerment in Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 雨中繁荣：孟加拉国的自然冲击、时间分配与女性赋权
articles.abstract_en: In low- and middle-income countries, differences between men and women in their time use patterns represent a major source of gender inequality. Among other factors, natural shocks can affect these differences. This paper examines the impact of the 2017 flood in Bangladesh on men’s and women’s time use patterns and women’s empowerment. Using georeferenced and longitudinal data, we find that the flood decreased women’s time spent on domestic work while increasing their engagement in income generating activities and empowerment. In contrast, men spent less time at work and increased their participation in domestic work to substitute for women’s. These responses to the shock are confirmed only for those individuals who were exposed to another flooding event that occurred in 2014. To better understand the underlying mechanisms, we look at the long-term impact of the 2014 flood on women’s empowerment and on their engagement in income generating activities, and we find that the shock still positively affects both variables. These results suggest that when an increase in empowerment naturally occurs within the household, it persists over time and influences reactions to subsequent shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 在低收入和中等收入国家，男性和女性在时间使用模式上的差异是性别不平等的一个主要来源。在其他因素中，自然冲击可能影响这些差异。本文考察了2017年孟加拉国洪水对男性和女性时间使用模式及女性赋权的影响。利用地理参考和纵向数据，我们发现洪水减少了女性在家务劳动上的时间，同时增加了她们参与创收活动和赋权的程度。相比之下，男性在工作上花费的时间减少，并增加了家务劳动的参与以替代女性。这些对冲击的反应仅在那些也经历了2014年发生的另一次洪水事件的个体中得到确认。为了更好地理解潜在机制，我们考察了2014年洪水对女性赋权及其参与创收活动的长期影响，发现该冲击仍然对这两个变量产生积极影响。这些结果表明，当赋权在家庭内部自然增加时，它会随着时间的推移持续存在，并影响对后续冲击的反应。

articles.title_en: Challenging and reinforcing the status quo: Services, civil society and conflict in the MENA region
articles.title_cn: 挑战与强化现状：中东和北非地区的服务、公民社会与冲突
articles.abstract_en: How and why do civil society organisations (CSOs) engage with service delivery and with what consequences for political change in conflict-affected contexts? Most existing work in this area focuses on specialist NGO service provision, concluding that this remains a relatively apolitical sphere of activity with little relevance for peace and conflict dynamics. By examining the experience of CSOs in three countries in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, we show that engagement with services plays a crucial, yet highly varied and hitherto under-studied, role in these organisations’ efforts to build legitimacy and pursue their political goals, with potentially important implications for peace and conflict dynamics. By bringing literature on social movements into conversation with research on NGOs and civil society in conflict settings, and drawing on interviews with key informants, we develop a novel tripartite framework for understanding civil society engagement with service delivery. We identify three main patterns where CSOs’ engagement with services contributes to political change and highlight the dynamic interaction between these three patterns: providing to initiate a challenge (where services provision is used as a means of establishing new organisations that are critical of the status quo by bolstering community-level legitimacy), protesting (where services are used as a focal point for critical groups’ mobilisation and coalition building) and providing to reinforce (where groups that are supportive of the status quo use civil society service provision to shore up support). We show that in the MENA region, civil society’s engagement with service delivery makes an important but mixed contribution to political change. While it can contribute indirectly to political transformation by cultivating the legitimacy of new civil society groups or provide a focal point for a wider critique of the status quo, it can also undermine a shift towards political transformation by entrenching the position of existing elites.
articles.abstract_cn: 公民社会组织（CSOs）如何以及为何参与服务提供，这在受冲突影响的背景下对政治变革有何影响？该领域大多数现有研究聚焦于专业非政府组织的服务提供，并得出结论认为这仍是一个相对非政治化的活动领域，与和平与冲突动态关系不大。通过考察中东和北非（MENA）地区三个国家的公民社会组织经验，我们表明，参与服务提供在这些组织建立合法性和追求政治目标的努力中扮演着关键但高度多样化且迄今研究不足的角色，对和平与冲突动态具有潜在的重要影响。通过将社会运动文献与冲突环境中非政府组织和公民社会研究进行对话，并利用对关键信息提供者的访谈，我们开发了一个新颖的三方框架来理解公民社会参与服务提供。我们识别出公民社会组织参与服务提供促进政治变革的三种主要模式，并强调这三种模式之间的动态互动：提供以发起挑战（服务提供被用作建立批评现状的新组织的手段，通过增强社区层面的合法性）、抗议（服务被用作批评群体动员和联盟建设的焦点）以及提供以强化（支持现状的群体利用公民社会服务提供来巩固支持）。我们表明，在中东和北非地区，公民社会参与服务提供对政治变革做出了重要但复杂的贡献。虽然它可以通过培养新公民社会群体的合法性间接促进政治转型，或为更广泛的现状批评提供焦点，但它也可能通过巩固现有精英的地位而削弱向政治转型的转变。

articles.title_en: The mixed impacts of peer punishments on common-pool resources: Multi-country experimental evidence
articles.title_cn: 同伴惩罚对公共池塘资源的混合影响：多国实验证据
articles.abstract_en: The conservation of common-pool resources (CPRs), such as tropical forests, is a key challenge of development and environmental policies. Peer sanctioning of excessive resource use increases the cost of free riding and may be an effective way to ensure sustainable management of CPRs, but it entails individual costs to punishers. This paper examines peer punishment patterns and impacts in a cross-country framed field experiment (FFE) with homogeneous and heterogenous agents. The FFE is conducted with 720 forest users in Brazil, Indonesia, and Peru. We first examine the relationship between the appropriation of the common-pool resource (first order cooperation) and peer punishment choices (second order cooperation), distinguishing between prosocial and antisocial punishment. A small share (18.2%) of the participants behaves as self-interested payoff maximisers (homo economicus), while the largest group (26.1%) cooperates in both the appropriation and punishment decisions (homo reciprocans). Across countries, receiving prosocial punishment, defined as punishment of free riders, increases cooperation, while receiving antisocial punishment reduces cooperation. There are, however, important inter-country variations. In Indonesia, the marginal costs of non-cooperation are higher than in the Brazilian and Peruvian sites, and agent heterogeneity significantly increases peer punishment frequency. We conjecture that the higher punishment frequency in Indonesia is linked to stronger equality norms and a willingness to enforce them. Although peer punishment boosts cooperation across all our study sites, the research highlights how peer punishment patterns and impacts are linked to the institutional and cultural contexts.
articles.abstract_cn: 公共池塘资源（如热带森林）的保护是发展和环境政策的关键挑战。对过度资源使用的同伴制裁增加了搭便车的成本，可能是确保公共池塘资源可持续管理的有效方式，但它给惩罚者带来了个人成本。本文在一个跨国的框架实地实验（FFE）中考察了同伴惩罚模式和影响，该实验涉及同质和异质代理人。FFE在巴西、印度尼西亚和秘鲁的720名森林使用者中进行。我们首先考察公共池塘资源的 appropriation（一阶合作）与同伴惩罚选择（二阶合作）之间的关系，区分亲社会惩罚和反社会惩罚。一小部分（18.2%）参与者表现为自利的收益最大化者（经济人），而最大的群体（26.1%）在 appropriation 和惩罚决策中都合作（互惠人）。在各国中，接受亲社会惩罚（定义为对搭便车者的惩罚）会增加合作，而接受反社会惩罚则会减少合作。然而，存在重要的国家间差异。在印度尼西亚，不合作的边际成本高于巴西和秘鲁的试验点，且代理人异质性显著增加了同伴惩罚频率。我们推测，印度尼西亚较高的惩罚频率与更强的平等规范及其执行意愿有关。尽管同伴惩罚在我们所有研究点都促进了合作，但研究强调了同伴惩罚模式和影响如何与制度和文化背景相关联。

articles.title_en: How natural resource rents, exports, and government resource revenues determine Genuine Savings: Causal evidence from oil, gas, and coal
articles.title_cn: 自然资源租金、出口和政府资源收入如何决定真实储蓄：来自石油、天然气和煤炭的因果证据
articles.abstract_en: Natural resource-rich countries face the challenge of harnessing their resources for sustainable economic development. Although existing literature extensively studies the resource curse phenomenon, gaps remain in understanding exactly how natural resource use impacts sustainable development. This study addresses this gap by analyzing how the natural resource conversion process affects sustainable economic development, using Genuine Savings as the key indicator. The natural resource conversion process encompasses four distinct stages—discovery, extraction, appropriation, and (re-)investments—that transform natural resources into human- and produced capital assets to achieve sustainable development, consistent with the weak sustainability paradigm. Employing a comprehensive dataset spanning 118 countries over 20 years, we use an instrumental variable approach to estimate the causal effects of four variables corresponding to the four stages of conversion: natural capital, natural resource rents, resource exports, and government resource revenues. Results show that energy rents (oil, gas, and coal) and exports jointly decrease Genuine Savings, except in countries with good institutions. Contrary to previous studies, we demonstrate that economies specializing heavily in energy exports successfully leverage their comparative advantage, increasing Genuine Savings. Other countries achieve sustainable development through energy extraction and domestic use of resources. We conclude that successful resource management for sustainable economic development aims to achieve two objectives. First, it seeks to reduce energy exports when at a comparative disadvantage or harness them when at a comparative advance. Second, it focuses on improving institutional quality.
articles.abstract_cn: 自然资源丰富的国家面临着利用其资源实现可持续经济发展的挑战。尽管现有文献广泛研究了资源诅咒现象，但在理解自然资源利用如何确切影响可持续发展方面仍存在空白。本研究通过分析自然资源转化过程如何影响可持续经济发展来填补这一空白，使用真实储蓄作为关键指标。自然资源转化过程包括四个不同的阶段——发现、开采、征用和（再）投资——这些阶段将自然资源转化为人力资本和生产性资本资产，以实现可持续发展，与弱可持续性范式一致。利用涵盖118个国家、20年的综合数据集，我们采用工具变量方法估计与转化四个阶段相对应的四个变量的因果效应：自然资本、自然资源租金、资源出口和政府资源收入。结果表明，能源租金（石油、天然气和煤炭）和出口共同降低了真实储蓄，除非在制度良好的国家。与先前研究相反，我们证明高度专业化于能源出口的经济体成功利用其比较优势，增加了真实储蓄。其他国家通过能源开采和国内资源使用实现可持续发展。我们得出结论，成功的资源管理以实现可持续经济发展旨在实现两个目标。首先，它寻求在处于比较劣势时减少能源出口，或在处于比较优势时利用它们。其次，它侧重于提高制度质量。

articles.title_en: The impact of Communist Party membership on wealth distribution and accumulation in urban China
articles.title_cn: 共产党员身份对中国城镇财富分配与积累的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides the first in-depth investigation into the evolution of the wealth gap between CCP and non-CCP households in urban China from 1995 to 2017. We apply unconditional quantile regression to analyze the variations in the premiums of party membership across the wealth distribution. Our results show that although the average wealth gap between CCP and non-CCP households remained substantial and consistent throughout the period, there have been significant shifts in the returns structure of party membership over time. Prior to the housing reform in the 1990s, the highest wealth premiums of CCP households were primarily concentrated in the middle of the distribution, but now they are concentrated at the bottom of the distribution. This is mainly attributed to the fact that CCP households at the lower end of the net wealth distribution are more inclined to possess housing assets, which tend to have higher value compared to those owned by non-CCP households. These effects fade out in the top half of the net wealth distribution, where the differences between CCP and non-CCP households become less apparent. Furthermore, by utilizing a balanced household panel from 2013 to 2017, we were able to track wealth accumulation at the household level. Our findings indicate that CCP households accumulate wealth faster than non-CCP households due to larger capital gains, and the differences between the two groups increase along the net wealth distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次深入研究了1995年至2017年间中国城镇共产党员家庭与非共产党员家庭财富差距的演变。我们应用无条件分位数回归分析党员身份溢价在财富分布上的变化。结果表明，尽管在整个时期内，共产党员家庭与非共产党员家庭的平均财富差距保持显著且稳定，但党员身份回报结构随时间发生了显著变化。在1990年代住房改革之前，共产党员家庭的最高财富溢价主要集中在分布的中部，而现在则集中在分布的底部。这主要归因于净财富分布较低端的共产党员家庭更倾向于拥有住房资产，而这些资产的价值往往高于非共产党员家庭所拥有的。这些效应在净财富分布的上半部分逐渐消失，共产党员家庭与非共产党员家庭之间的差异变得不那么明显。此外，通过利用2013年至2017年的平衡家庭面板数据，我们能够追踪家庭层面的财富积累。我们的研究结果表明，由于更大的资本收益，共产党员家庭的财富积累速度快于非共产党员家庭，且两组之间的差异沿净财富分布递增。

articles.title_en: Structural change and poverty reduction in developing economies
articles.title_cn: 发展中经济体的结构变迁与减贫
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents an empirical framework that explores the relationship between poverty reduction and changes in the production structure of developing countries. We use the new GGDC/UNU-WIDER Economic Transformation Database to measure productivity growth within sectors and structural change – the reallocation of workers across sectors – for 42 developing countries from 1990 to 2018. Regression analysis indicates that poverty reduction significantly relates to productivity growth, particularly within manufacturing, and to structural change. An attribution analysis suggests that structural change and increased agricultural productivity contributed to reducing poverty in developing countries of Asia and sub-Saharan Africa. The contribution of productivity growth in manufacturing appears to be a prominent factor in poverty reduction in developing Asia but less so in sub-Saharan Africa.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个实证框架，探讨减贫与发展中国家生产结构变化之间的关系。我们利用新的GGDC/UNU-WIDER经济转型数据库，衡量了1990年至2018年间42个发展中国家的部门内生产率增长和结构变迁——即工人跨部门的重新配置。回归分析表明，减贫与生产率增长（尤其是制造业内部的生产率增长）以及结构变迁显著相关。一项归因分析表明，结构变迁和农业生产率的提高有助于减少亚洲和撒哈拉以南非洲发展中国家的贫困。制造业生产率增长的贡献似乎是发展中亚洲减贫的一个突出因素，但在撒哈拉以南非洲则不那么显著。

excluded_items.title_en: Does export underreporting contribute to the resource curse?
